name: agentgpt
description: Trigger autonomous AI agents via AgentGPT from OpenClaw
author: AgentGPT Integration

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Create and run an autonomous AI agent
examples: /agent "Research Bot" - Research the latest developments in quantum computing

goal.description: The objective or goal for the agent to accomplish
